newsitem.title: USA: Input/Output sees Q3 EPS $0.10 to $0.15.
newsitem.headline: Input/Output sees Q3 EPS $0.10 to $0.15.

text.p: Input/Output Thursday said that for the third quarter ended February 28 it expects net earnings to range from $4.5 million to $6.5 million, or $0.10 to $0.15 per share and net revenues to range from $60 million to $65 million.
In the comparable quarter in fiscal 1996 the company reported net earnings of $11.8 million, or $0.27 per share on revenues of $79.1 million.

The company said its results were adversely affected by competitive pressures in the land seismic equipment market, which were partially offset by demand for radio telemetery systems and strong marine streamer system sales. In addition the company said that to date only one of the delayed sales from the second quarter had materialized.
"With the information we have today, we see reasonable demand for each of our product lines in the fourth quarter," said president and chief executive officer Gary Owens.
Input/Output expects to report its final third quarter results March 18.
